1. (Currently Amended) A composition, comprising: cavity-generating particles; a thermally conductive binder __that is cured at a temperature above 200°C__; and a solvent.

2. (Previously Presented) The composition of claim 1, wherein the composition is applied to an electronic component surface.

3. (Previously Presented) The composition of claim 2, wherein the solvent is removed during application to the electronic component surface.

9. (Currently Amended) A composition comprising cavity generating particles, a binder, and a carrier wherein the particle to binder ratio being about 1 gram to 0.5-0.8 grams and the carrier being about 10 ml per gram of particles, __and wherein the cavity generating particles have a size distribution with at least 50% of the particles being larger than 50 micrometers__.

10. (Previously Presented) The composition of claim 9, wherein the carrier is selected from the group comprising ethyl alcohol, isopropyl alcohol, acetone, methylethyl ketone, FC-72, or FC-87.

11. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 9, wherein the binder is __a__ premixed solder paste __having a melting point below 300°C__.

12. (Previously Presented) The composition of claim 9, wherein the cavity generating particles are selected from the group comprising nickel, copper, aluminum, silver, iron, brass and alloys.

13. (Previously Presented) The composition of claim 9, wherein the cavity generating particles are 8-12 pm in size.

14. (Previously Presented) The composition of claim 9, wherein the cavity generating particles are 30-50 pm in size.

15. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 9, wherein the cavity generating particles are 100-200 __micrometers__ in size __and have an irregular surface morphology__.

16. (Currently Amended) A composition of matter comprising carrier, binder, and cavity generating particles, wherein said composition of matter contains, in relative proportion: about 10 ml carrier; about 0.5 to 0.8 grams binder; and about 1 gram of cavity generating particles, __and wherein the cavity generating particles have a size distribution with at least 50% of the particles being larger than 50 micrometers__.

17. (Previously Presented) The composition of claim 16, wherein the carrier is selected from the group comprising ethyl alcohol, isopropyl alcohol, acetone, methylethyl ketone, FC-72, or FC-87.

18. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 16, wherein the binder is __a__ premixed solder paste __having a melting point below 300°C__.

19. (Previously Presented) The composition of claim 16, wherein the cavity generating particles are selected from the group comprising nickel, copper, aluminum, silver, iron, brass and alloys.

20. (Previously Presented) The composition of claim 16, wherein the cavity generating particles are 8-12 pm in size.

21. (Previously Presented) The composition of claim 16, wherein the cavity generating particles are 30-50 p m in size.

22. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 16, wherein the cavity generating particles are 100-200 __micrometers__ in size __and have an irregular surface morphology__.
